Package ch.colabproject.colab.api.controller

Class DuplicationManager

java.lang.Object
ch.colabproject.colab.api.controller.DuplicationManager
public class DuplicationManager extends Object
Duplication of colab entities.

Usage :

  • Create a DuplicationManager
  • Duplicate the object with any duplicateXXX
  • Save to JPA database
  • Call duplicateDataIntoJCR() in order to save to JCR database
